definitions.known_precision: correct links / accepted links among queries whose player has a gallery (wrong known links count against it; unknown queries do not enter)
definitions.unknown_false_match_rate: accepted links / unknown queries, natural (no gallery yet) and synthetic (own gallery removed) pooled; the natural rate is also reported and flagged if above the bound

criterion.scope: pooled over the test matches of the locked rule; every bound must hold; per-match results reported
